name: autocad-mcp
description: An experimental Model Context Protocol bridge for full AutoCAD 2021-2026 on Windows
author: AutoCAD MCP Contributors

tools.name: draw_line
tools.description: Draw a line in AutoCAD between two 3D points

tools.name: draw_circle
tools.description: Draw a circle in AutoCAD with a center and radius

tools.name: extrude_profile
tools.description: Create a 3D solid by extruding a profile

tools.name: revolve_profile
tools.description: Create a 3D solid by revolving a profile around an axis

tools.name: list_entities
tools.description: List entities in the current AutoCAD drawing

tools.name: get_entity_info
tools.description: Get details for a drawing entity in the current session

tools.name: server_status
tools.description: Report MCP server and AutoCAD connection status

resources.description: Current MCP server and AutoCAD connection status

prompts.name: autocad-help
prompts.description: Get help with registered AutoCAD MCP tools

dependencies: Windows COM support for AutoCAD automation

steps: Install a targeted full AutoCAD release on Windows
Install Python 3.12 or newer and uv
Start the stdio server with: uv run python src/server.py
